title: Fleet Unit Delivery Rate Card by Price Class
content:
**Deal desk rate card, Vehicle Purchase Agreements, Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement home delivery**

The per-mile delivery rate for a fleet unit follows the vehicle price charged on the deal. That is the amount posted on the deal as the vehicle price charge.

| Vehicle price charged on the deal | Rate per chargeable delivery mile |
|---|---|
| At least USD 60000.00 | USD 1.60 |
| At least USD 45000.00 and below USD 60000.00 | USD 1.45 |
| Below USD 45000.00 | No price-class rate; the deal type's home delivery per-mile rate applies |

## Clause

A unit whose vehicle price charged is at least 60000.00 is charged 1.60 per chargeable delivery mile. A unit whose vehicle price charged is at least 45000.00 and below 60000.00 is charged 1.45 per chargeable delivery mile. Every other unit is charged the deal type's home delivery per-mile rate.

## Edges of each band

| Hypothetical vehicle price charged | Band reached | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 60000.00 | top band (at the figure) | 1.60 |
| 59999.99 | middle band | 1.45 |
| 45000.00 | middle band (at the figure) | 1.45 |
| 44999.99 | below both bands | deal type's per-mile rate |

## Reading the price

The figure tested is the vehicle price posted on the deal as the vehicle price charge. It does not include the documentary fee, taxes, title and registration amounts, or any other charge posted on the deal.

**Hypothetical example.** A unit with a vehicle price charged of 52340.00 sits in the middle band. Each chargeable delivery mile is charged at 1.45, so 37 chargeable miles come to 53.65.
